Rules: real_exam/TEACHING_STYLE_GUIDE.md R1-R35 (no 'which way is better' verdict) + NITZAN_RHYTHM_DELIVERY.md P1-P13. Calm preset on the question reading and plain calculations.
slides: Let's continue with percentages, and see one more strength of the ratio table.

slides.say: Fifteen percent of a number is fifty-four. What is twenty-five percent of the same number?
Fifteen percent and fifty-four go in the first row. Twenty-five percent and a question mark go in the last row.
at: Twenty-five percent and a question mark

slides: With an equation, we'd first find the whole number, and then take twenty-five percent of it. With the table, we don't need the whole.

slides.say: Fifteen percent is fifty-four. Let's divide both by three. Fifteen divided by three is five. Fifty-four divided by three is eighteen. So five percent is eighteen.
Twenty-five percent is five times five percent. So it's five times eighteen, ninety.
So we went straight to what they asked. We never found the whole.
The third way is ten percent. Ten percent is always easy to find, because it's just dividing by ten.
Ten percent of two hundred forty is twenty-four. We just take off the zero.
Ten percent of forty-eight is four point eight. The decimal point moves one place to the left.

slides: By the way, decimals like four point eight are rare on the exam. Most of the time, the numbers come out round.

slides.say: Now we build other percents from ten percent. What is thirty percent of two hundred forty?
Thirty percent is three times ten percent. Ten percent is twenty-four, so thirty percent is three times twenty-four, seventy-two.
at: so thirty percent is three times

slides.say: What about thirty-five percent? We split it into thirty percent and five percent.
Thirty percent is seventy-two, as we just saw. Five percent is half of ten percent. Half of twenty-four is twelve.
Together, seventy-two plus twelve is eighty-four. So thirty-five percent of two hundred forty is eighty-four.
Ten percent also helps when the whole is missing. Thirty percent of a number is sixty-three. What is the number?
at: Thirty percent of a number is sixty-three

slides.say: Thirty percent is three times ten percent. So ten percent is sixty-three divided by three, twenty-one.
The whole is a hundred percent, ten times ten percent. Ten times twenty-one is two hundred ten.
Let's check. Ten percent of two hundred ten is twenty-one, and three times twenty-one is sixty-three. It works.
Let's sum up. Percent means over a hundred, and of means times.

We saw three ways to calculate. The percent equation works every time. The ratio table is quick, and we don't always need the whole. And ten-percent chunks are the fastest in your head, when the percents are round.

And know the fraction table by heart. A half, a quarter, an eighth, a tenth, a fifth, a twentieth, a third and a sixth. [pause] Take a moment to memorize the table on the memory card. In the next lesson we'll see a percent of a percent, and I'll see you in the next video.
